newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China sees $12 bln trade surplus in 1997.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China sees $12 bln trade surplus in 1997.

text.p: China is expected to have a trade surplus of about $12 billion for all of 1997, according to forecast by economists from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and the State Statistics Bureau on Friday.
Exports were forecast to rise 9.0 percent to $165 billion while imports would climb 9.9 percent to $153 billion, said the report, excerpts of which were issued by the Xinhua news agency.
China reported a trade surplus of $12.24 billion on total trade of $289.9 billion last year.
China has set a total trade goal of $310 billion for this year.
